exposure: documented psychiatric history without antepartum inpatient treatment
no documented psychiatric history or antepartum treatment
gestational age at first prenatal visit
cohort: Women who gave birth between January 1, 2006, and December 31, 2016
finding: Receiving antepartum inpatient psychiatric care may promote positive birth outcomes for women with acutely severe psychiatric conditions.
mod_finding: The study found that women receiving antepartum inpatient psychiatric care had longer gestational lengths and gave birth to heavier babies compared to those with psychiatric history but no inpatient care, suggesting a potential influence on mode of delivery, although the specific relationship was not investigated.
